doc.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview

chapter: Joining the Messengers and moving to New York
title: Clifford Brown's death and scuffling in New York
summary: The Messengers lose Clifford and Richie Powell, and Ware and Ira Sullivan struggle for money in New York.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Lose Clifford and Richie Powell got killed in an automobile accident. But that was the first engagement That Art Blakey was (inaudible) beautiful, he'd tell Ira and I, "We got to scuffle and we kind of had to scuttle for ourselves now; he said he was gonna put us out on the corner of 52nd and Broadway and said, 'be right back' and then he'd drive off. That's after the engagement.

Well in New York, we knew a lot of musicians, you know, but New York is New York, and he might give you his phone number, but no address. So our money was so tight, we didn't have nothing to get into Even in those big hotels, it wasn't much.
